agent.finish_summary: Fixed BarrelList.pop() in boltons/listutils.py. The index-based pop branch had inverted logic: it deleted the entire sublist whenever it was non-empty after popping (the 'else' branch), silently discarding most of the remaining data, while leaving genuinely empty sublists in place. This matches the reported failure (87380 == 100002, i.e. a ~12.5k-element sublist being wrongly discarded). The fix removes the erroneous 'else: del lists[list_idx]' branch so a sublist is only deleted when it is actually empty after the pop. Verified by reproducing the exact reported scenario (100000-element range + 3 appends + pop(50000) -> len now correctly 100002) and by a randomized stress test comparing 500 pops against a plain Python list, with matching popped values, final contents, and length.
